name: Light My Way
source:
Light My Way is a Kinetic Novel that takes place on the continent of Stradia, where our fox hero, Lucian, will have to deal with his unnatural powers, navigate through friends and foes, and experience love, hate, deceit, and much more.

Join him in unraveling the mystery of the lights that surround him and others around him in this thrilling Kinetic Novel!

[from [url=https://batstudios47.itch.io/lightmyway]itch.io[/url]]
